thread:
maya: Heads-up — we saw a short spike in 5xxs hitting /v1/generate around 09:12 UTC from prod-us-west. Where are the canonical dashboards for 4xx/5xx and what's the recommended alert tuning? Customers reported failures.

ops-bot: ALERT: prod /v1/generate 5xx_rate > 2% (1m) — triggered at 2024-03-16T09:12:42Z. Incident id: INC-5142.

sam: Grafana panels: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd/errors-overview — top-level 4xx/5xx by service. For per-route view use the 'Route 5xx rate' and 'Route 4xx rate' dashboards.

jordan: Quick queries you can run in Prometheus:
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{env=\"prod\",job=\"ingress\",route=\"/v1/generate\",status=~\"5..\"}[5m]))
/ sum(rate(http_requests_total{env=\"prod\",job=\"ingress\",route=\"/v1/generate\"}[5m])) * 100
```
Use that to compute percent 5xx for the route. For cluster-wide 5xx use status=~"5.." without route.

li: Traces are in Tempo — example for a recent 502: https://tempo.redwood.ai/trace/1a2b3c — look for upstream timeouts and `nginx` 502 responses. Also check `request_duration_seconds` p95 and `upstream_connect_time`.

anna: We have two alerts for this: `prod-high-5xx-rate` (threshold 1.5% over 5m -> pager) and `prod-5xx-warning` (0.8% over 10m -> slack). Maybe the 1.5% is too sensitive for bursty traffic — could lower pager to 3% and keep slack at 1%. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

sam: Quick tuning suggestion: keep pager for sustained >3% over 10m OR sudden spike >5% in 1m. Keep slack at 1% for ops awareness. Also add a rate-by-route exception for our long-poll endpoints.

maya: Sounds reasonable. Is there an easy way to exclude healthcheck noise? We get some 4xxs from internal probes.

jordan: Yes, add `{src!="healthcheck"}` to the PromQL filters or exclude `route=~"/hc.*"`. Example: `http_requests_total{env="prod", route!~"/hc.*"}`

li: For debugging action items: check ingress logs (Fluentd index: logs-prod-ingress, search "route=\"/v1/generate\" status>=500"), check K8s pod restarts `kubectl -n prod get pods -o wide | grep generate`, and grab a sample trace id.

ops-bot: Incident INC-5142 updated: assigned to @maya, severity: S2, runbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/ingress-5xx.

maya: I'll take this. Plan: 1) triage logs + trace (10m), 2) if repeated, temp rollback to model v2.1 for /v1/generate (coord with @sam), 3) PR to adjust pager threshold to 3% and add route exception.

anna: If you need a quick hotfix for alert config, I can push it (ops-edit perms). Ping me when ready. :thumbsup:

maya: Quick repro command I used: `curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @payload.json` — use `-v` to see TCP-level timeouts.

sam: Also check LB logs for 504/gateway timeouts — metric: `loadbalancer_response_code_total{code="504"}`. If LB 504s spike it's upstream slowness, not app exceptions.

jordan: FYI saved panels: Errors -> Overview, Errors by Route, 4xx/5xx Trends. Bookmark: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd/errors-overview?view=routes

maya: Great, I'll post summary in incidents channel after triage. Thanks all. :eyes:
